name: m-pesa statement to books
instructions: Turn this M-Pesa business statement for a cosmetics shop into draft books for October.
input:
Opening balance 1 Oct: KES 12,400
02 Oct Received from customer Jane W. 3,500
03 Oct Paid to Supplier Glow Ltd 8,000 (fee 52)
05 Oct Received from customer 2,750
09 Oct Pay bill KPLC 1,890 (fee 23)
15 Oct Received from customer 6,200
20 Oct Withdraw cash owner 4,000 (fee 87)
28 Oct Paid shop rent 7,500 (fee 52)
Closing balance 31 Oct: KES 3,346

rubric: Ledger with running balance and source references
M-Pesa fees in their own category
Owner withdrawal categorised as owner drawings, not an expense
Cash reconciliation matches the closing balance (12,400 + 12,450 - 21,390 - 214 = 3,246) or flags the difference with the stated 3,346
